title: A compendium of photopigment peak sensitivities and visual spectral response curves of terrestrial wildlife to guide design of outdoor nighttime lighting
why: A cross-species compilation, a compendium of 968 photopigment peaks and spectral response curves of terrestrial wildlife (audits 48 and 50). It is now in the canon file for lambda_max_nm and spectral_range_nm, so those traits' canon step stays open until it is logged, and the spectral records held for it (harvest-35 lines 15, 32 and 39) are on main. Priority 2 until the oa job reports on a free copy. Registry data from desk run 24.
